summary: You write a prompt with four parts (goal, files to look at, rules, what to show when done), ask an agent for the --only option of run_golden.py, and review the diff with an eight-question checklist, running it with wrong input. The real findings: a typo that ran zero questions with exit code 0, and a report that was overwritten.
goal: Ask an agent for a small feature and review the diff.

items.text: Write your prompt with the four parts and predict what the agent will get wrong
Branch, give the prompt to your agent and let it work
Read the diff line by line with the checklist and run the feature with a wrong input
Write each finding with how you found it: observed or read
Fix the findings, run pytest, mypy and the golden table, and commit
Play the Review the Diff game to the end and see your score
